purpose: Teach: フラメンコ/イケメン/ハングル/ヒップ/ヒーリング/ショパン/アキバ/レッズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフラメンコの本をお持ちなのよ
lines.en: Sho, did you know your dad has a book about flamenco?
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone with gentle curiosity. Soft opening. Presents the observation like a small gift, unhurried. Slight lift at the end—inviting him to join her notice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがイケメンって言われてるよ
lines.en: Mei-san, people keep saying my dad is really handsome.
lines.style: Bright, almost proud. Quick tempo. The words tumble out earnest and unguarded. A small laugh underneath—he's testing her reaction, seeking confirmation of something he's noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハングルの絵本を読んで下さるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad reads Korean picture books to you, doesn't he?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, not a question for information. Warm but observant—she's reflecting back something she's witnessed. Soft trailing quality, like she's saying it partly to herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ヒップホップダンスやってみたいよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I want to try hip-hop dancing.
lines.style: Direct, enthusiastic. Fresh energy—the idea just arrived and he's sharing it immediately. Slight breathiness on the verb, like momentum. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヒーリングの音楽を流して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father plays healing music for you, doesn't he?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy quality. Slow pace. She's speaking partly in wonder at how tender his father is. Quiet contentment underneath. Trailing off slightly, lost in the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとショパンの曲を聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I listened to Chopin with my dad the other day.
lines.style: Warm recollection, almost shy about the memory. Gentle pace. He's offering her something genuine—a moment he treasures. Soft finish, like he's keeping part of it private.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアキバの博物館に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is taking you to the Akihabara museum, I hear.
lines.style: Delighted on his behalf. Conversational but with genuine warmth. The information lands like good news she's sharing with him. Light, present tone throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとレッズの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I watched the Reds game with my dad.
lines.style: Proud and glowing. Bright, quick pace. The memory sits right at the surface—excitement mixed with quiet satisfaction. Close, intimate tone, like he's sharing something just with her.
